newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks slightly up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks slightly up on speculative buying.

text.p: Pakistan stocks were slightly up in early Friday morning mainly on speculative buying of select blue chips, but overall sentiment remained weak on lack of investors' interest, dealers said.
"It is a dull market as major investors are on the sidelines," one dealer said. "Only speculators are generating activity."

The index rose 1.42 points, or 0.09 percent, to 1,540.41 after 90 minutes of trading. Losers led gainers 93 to 37. PTCL rose 0.3 rupees to 25.1 and Dewan Salman Fibres up 0.6 to 34.9. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
